options.text: The judge may weigh conflicting affidavits and decide who is credible at summary judgment in this situation.

options.text: Summary judgment tests the pleadings rather than the evidentiary record as the record shows.
options.misconception: confuses summary judgment with dismissal

Each distractor rests on a different mistake about how the doctrine operates.
